item.title: All 14 Star Trek Movies, Ranked By Fans
item.description: The Star Trek franchise spans five decades and 14 releases, starting with The Motion Picture in 1979 and reaching the 2025 premiere of Section 31. These films follow the original crew led by William Shatner, Patrick Stewart’s Next Generation cast, and Chris Pine’s Kelvin timeline ensemble. We've included the critical scores for each, but ultimately it's up to you to decide which Star Trek movie reigns supreme.

item.title: All 12 Star Trek TV Shows, Ranked By Fans
item.description: The Star Trek universe spans nearly six decades and twelve distinct series. Since Gene Roddenberry launched the franchise in 1966, these shows have explored different corners of the Federation through unique approaches to space travel and philosophy. Fans debate which entries best capture the essence of Trek, ranging from classic episodic adventures to serialized modern dramas. Help us decide which series really beams you up.

item.title: Controversial Double-Standard Stories From People Who Can't Tell If They're Overreacting
item.description: Double standards are maddening. But is it fair, or even appropriate, to point them out? That's the conundrum faced by plenty of Redditors in the r/AmIOverreacting subreddit.From feeling hurt because your girlfriend has double standards about being friends with members of the opposite sex to minding your parents' double standards about discipline, there's plenty of controversy to be found in these posts.Stories have been edited for length and clarity.
